authorityBinding.bindingRule: The independent review pins the exact authority, token, validator and package bytes. All four artifacts and the package append are introduced together; this token does not self-pin or create a cyclic artifact hash.

execution.changedPathRule: The committed changed paths are a nonempty subset of generationExecution.maximumChangedPaths in the bound authority; byte-identical allowlisted outputs are omitted and every unlisted path fails closed.
requiredOutcomes: Create one immutable product-authorization v62 DRAFT successor with exactly one capability and one dedicated Approval ACTION route over byte-identical v61.
Generate the canonical alias, immutable v62 bundle, indexes, optional deterministic fixture successor, Auth seed artifacts, explicit Approval PEP and version-62 service PEP artifacts.
Run only the authority-bound generator checks and named tests once, correcting and rerunning only the smallest failed target.
Commit and push only the exact verified generation-lane tree and issue external hash-bound verification and independent-review receipts.

requiredBeforeCommit: exact changed-path subset and regular-file mode check
DRAFT, zero automatic import, zero activation and no migration assertions
requiredBeforePush: independent source review reports zero unresolved P0, P1 and P2
lane commit is one non-merge direct child of the exact base
lane tree and every changed artifact byte and SHA-256 are recorded in the external targeted-verification receipt
requiredAfterPush: the post-implementation review receipt pins the targeted-verification receipt, exact lane commit, tree and changed paths
the post-implementation review receipt records zero P0, P1 and P2 and GO_FOR_AUTH_V62_GENERATION_LANE_BRANCH_PUSH_ONLY
the receipt causal order is lane commit <= targeted verification <= independent review <= push observation <= receipt recording
both external receipts are current-user 0600 single-link regular no-follow files within the sealed size bound
requiredBeforeBackendDwpDevIntegration: a separate central integration authority exists
the sixth-validator two-file descendant-governance side carrier is merged and pushed on frontend dwp-dev
the external descendant-governance receipt passes the immutable sixth validator

forbidden: Auth V271 reservation, SQL authoring or control-plane implementation
runtime Java implementation other than the two exact ProductAuthorizationContractValidator and ProductAuthorizationReleaseLineage compatibility paths
seed-loader, release-lineage, fixture-adapter or Gateway production implementation beyond the exact optional test-only paths in the bound authority
Approval, People, Time, Payroll or Auth HRM-013 controller, relay, client, repository or runtime implementation
People database migration V62 or Approval database migration V60
frontend UI, sidebar, menu or route work
feature enablement, automatic bundle import, tenant enrollment, assignment, grant, credential or key creation
direct backend dwp-dev merge, rebase or squash
repository-wide test execution without an append-only authority successor
